# SOL Systems Explorer
Interactive technical visualization for complex hardware.
Current self-serve product: Explorer Starter Kit, planned public price $79, checkout activation pending.
Current custom pilot: $2,500-$5,000 planning range.
Technical explorer: $10,000-$30,000 planning range.
Demonstrated: browser visualization, mobile navigation, guided subsystem inspection, agent-readable offer metadata.
Not claimed: customer deployments, authoritative digital twin, automated CAD conversion, PLM/MBSE integration, live telemetry.
Machine-readable: /agent/catalog.json and /agent/capabilities.json
